# owner: platform
"""Weekly timesheet lines built from a list of shifts."""

from collections import Counter

from hourglass.schedule import worker_minutes


def _busiest_first(item):
    name, minutes = item
    return (-minutes, name)


# ---
def timesheet_lines(shifts):
    """One line per worker: name, shift count, hours."""
    if not shifts:
        raise ValueError("no shifts to total")
    if any(not s.worker.strip() for s in shifts):
        raise ValueError("shift has a blank worker name")
    counts = Counter(s.worker for s in shifts)
    totals = worker_minutes(shifts)
    ordered = sorted(totals.items(), key=_busiest_first)
    return [
        f"{name}: {counts[name]} shifts, {m / 60:.1f} h"
        for name, m in ordered
    ]
